data.explanation: This is a second reminder about an unpaid balance for furniture you ordered, including a €5.00 reminder fee. Check whether you have already paid this amount. If not, pay the full €695.00 by the deadline shown. If you don't pay in time, the company says it will hand the claim over to a debt collection agency (Inkassounternehmen), and you would then also have to cover the collection costs on top of the debt. If you believe the amount is wrong, contact the seller directly before the deadline.
